messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "stopped several days before clonidine is withdrawn"
set: ["stopped several days before clonidine is withdrawn", "clonidine", "long-term treatment is not usually stopped before surgery", "after medicine is stopped", "several days or longer", "clonidine withdrawal", "14 days before the period is due", "measurable within first several days", "can take several days of regular once-daily use before full effect", "most settle after the medicine is stopped", "high blood sugar when medicine is stopped", "therapy should be withdrawn", "symptoms can take several days to develop", "given for at least five days before the dose is increased", "if stopped or interrupted for several days, treatment should start again", "several weeks"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
